title.en: Remove the script that fingerprints the audio stack

detail.en: A script generates a sound nobody hears and reads the processed signal back; the tiny differences between devices are the identifier. Remove the script, or switch the feature off with the vendor.

snippet:
<!-- remove the tag, or load it only after consent -->
<!-- <script src="https://{{host}}/…"></script> -->

forwardable.en: Or forward it to your developer — it reads the same either way.

body.en:
On {{domain}}, a script served from {{host}} creates an OfflineAudioContext with an oscillator on {{page}} and reads the rendered samples back. Nothing is played; that is device fingerprinting.

Find where the {{host}} script is included and remove it. If it belongs to a vendor we need, ask them for the setting that disables device fingerprinting and apply it, or load their script only after the visitor has consented.

When you are done: show me the change and how to confirm no script on https://{{domain}}{{page}} creates an audio context on a fresh load.
